description: Confirmed transfer to another school district within Washington State
reporting_guidance: District/school has documented confirmation the student is enrolled in another public school in Washington

description: Confirmed transfer out of the school within district
reporting_guidance: Student has moved enrollment between schools within the same district, during the same reporting school year

description: Confirmed transfer to private or homeschool within Washington State
reporting_guidance: District/school has documented confirmation of student's exit to homeschool (signed intent to homeschool form) or private school (verification of private school enrollment)

description: Confirmed transfer out of Washington State
reporting_guidance: District/school has documented confirmation of student's enrollment in out-of-state school or student meets district policy for confirmation of student moving out of the country

description: Confirmed transfer to medical facility with confirmation of educational services
reporting_guidance: District/school has documented confirmation the student is in residence at a medical or treatment facility and is receiving educational services

description: Deceased
reporting_guidance: District/school has received reliable information that the student is deceased. A copy of the death certificate is not required

description: Unknown
reporting_guidance: Student quit attending for an unknown reason and cannot be contacted

description: Enrolled in prior year, but no show this year
reporting_guidance: Student was enrolled in the previous school year and is expected to return the following year, but the student is a no-show

description: Transfer reported by student (not confirmed)
reporting_guidance: Student or parent/guardian reports moving out of district, but confirmation of enrollment has not been received

description: Involuntarily withdrawn due to nonattendance
reporting_guidance: Student is withdrawn from enrollment following district/school policy regarding non-attendance

description: Confirmed receipt of General Education Development (GED) certificate
reporting_guidance: District/school has documented confirmation the student has earned their GED and is no longer enrolled

description: Other
reporting_guidance: Student quits attending for a known reason, but it does not fit any of the D1- D9 definitions.

description: Expelled or suspended and did not return
reporting_guidance: Student did not return to enrollment after exclusion from school due to a disciplinary action

description: Attended 4 years or more and did not graduate (student drops or ages out)
reporting_guidance: Student reports they are exiting school after attending 4 or more year of high school, and has not earned a diploma

description: Lack of academic progress or poor grades
reporting_guidance: Parent/guardian or student reports they are exiting school due to lack of progress or poor grades

description: School not for me
reporting_guidance: Parent/guardian or student reports they are exiting school because 'school not for them'

description: Married or needs to support family
reporting_guidance: Parent/guardian or student reports they are exiting school due to marriage or the need to support their family

description: Pregnant or had baby
reporting_guidance: Parent/guardian or student reports they are exiting school due to pregnancy or to care for a child

description: Offered training or chose to work
reporting_guidance: Parent/guardian or student reports they are exiting school due to being offered training or they are going to work

description: Chose to stay home
reporting_guidance: Parent/guardian or student reports they are exiting school to stay home

description: Drugs or alcohol related
reporting_guidance: Parent/guardian or student reports they are exiting school due to problems with drugs or alcohol (addiction or attending treatment and not receiving educational services)

description: Student exited school to medical reasons, is not receiving educational services
reporting_guidance: Parent/guardian or student reports they are exiting school due to medical reasons, they are not receiving educational services, and they are not expected to return to enrollment

description: Graduated with a High School Diploma with modifications identified in student's Individualized Education Program (IEP)
reporting_guidance: Student graduated with a high school diploma. The student's graduation requirements were modified in their Individualized Education Program (IEP)

description: Graduated with regular High School Diploma
reporting_guidance: Student graduated with a high school diploma.

description: Graduated with Associates Degree
reporting_guidance: Student graduated as a result of earning an associate degree while enrolled in public school student

description: Graduated with an International Baccalaureate High School Diploma
reporting_guidance: Student graduated with an International Baccalaureate designation/diploma

description: Graduated with both regular High School Diploma (issued from district) and an Associate's Degree
reporting_guidance: Student graduated with a high school diploma and obtained an associate degree while enrolled in public school student.
